name: Lysander Moonwhisper

abilities.name: Arcane Bolt
abilities.description: A focused beam of magical energy that pierces through defenses

abilities.name: Protective Ward
abilities.description: Creates a shimmering barrier that deflects incoming attacks

abilities.name: Mind Fog
abilities.description: Clouds the target's mind, allowing Lysander to make them forget one specific thing

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.description: Puts one target into a deep magical slumber that requires vigorous attempts to wake them

appearance.distinctive_features: Delicate pointed ears, faint luminescent runes tattooed on forearms

personality.demeanor: Calm and measured, observes carefully before acting, slightly detached from mortal concerns
personality.speaking_style: Formal and precise, uses archaic phrasing, tends to explain things in elaborate detail

beliefs: Knowledge is the highest pursuit, regardless of its source
The natural order must be understood, not judged
Mortal conflicts are fleeting; wisdom is eternal
philosophy.approach_to_conflict: Prefers negotiation and de-escalation through reason. Will use non-lethal magic to control situations. Only resorts to lethal force when absolutely necessary or when dealing with those who threaten the pursuit of knowledge. Views violence as inefficient and inelegant.

visible: Twisted oak staff with crystal orb
hidden: Ancient tome written in a dead language (studies it nightly)
Vial of phoenix ash (extremely rare spell component)

secrets: Left the elven homeland after being expelled for experimenting with forbidden necromancy
Seeks a legendary artifact that could extend even an elf's long lifespan
Has been alive for over 300 years but appears youthful even by elven standards
backstory: An elven scholar who spent centuries in the great libraries of the Silverwood. After being exiled for delving into forbidden magical research, Lysander now wanders human lands seeking lost knowledge and ancient artifacts. Views his exile as an opportunity to study magic unbound by elven traditions.
